subject: Correction to Circle/Binance equity-closing status; Circle Q3 2026 financial context; XRP spot and derivatives provider-scope disagreement

correction.prior_claim: The Binance $100 million Circle equity investment was announced, but closing should not be assumed without a subsequent filing.
correction.corrected_claim: The $100 million private placement closed on 2026-09-17. Circle's Form 8-K filed 2026-09-22 states that Circle issued and sold 1,237,011 Class A shares to Binance at $80.84 per share for aggregate proceeds of $100 million. The filing says closing occurred substantially concurrently with, and immediately following, execution and delivery of the subscription agreement and expanded commercial arrangements.
correction.reason: The SEC Form 8-K is a later primary filing that directly documents issuance, sale and closing; the prior addendum's caution is now stale.

reported_metrics.limitation: Gross on-chain transfer volume is not equivalent to net new capital, unique economic activity or XRP demand.

reported_metrics.notes: Includes approximately $182 million of ARC token presale revenue.
Non-recurring presale revenue; not reserve income and not evidence of a publicly traded ARC token.
The Q3 presentation separately reports approximately $135 million adjusted EBITDA excluding ARC presale effects; headline growth should not be treated as purely recurring stablecoin economics.

reported_metrics.limitation: Annualized trailing-period measure, not actual quarterly settled value.

circle_q3_context.interpretation: Circle's Q3 headline revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth was materially influenced by ARC token presale revenue while reserve income declined 8% year over year. The $13.9 trillion on-chain volume metric must not be described as $13.9 trillion of new capital or real-economy payments. CPN's $41.3 billion is annualized TPV, not quarterly settled capital.

tazapay_acquisition.interpretation: These are Circle's reported Tazapay scale figures. They are not Circle's own realized quarterly volume and the acquisition has not closed.

samsung_wallet_usdc.user_scope: eligible Samsung Galaxy users in the United States
samsung_wallet_usdc.destination_scope: qualifying bank accounts in more than 60 countries
samsung_wallet_usdc.interpretation: USDC payment access through Samsung Wallet; no XRP use or XRPL settlement was established by this announcement.

visa_direct_usdc.channel: Visa Direct stablecoin prefunding through Inyo Global
visa_direct_usdc.interpretation: Circle describes a move from pilots to commercial deployment. The announcement does not quantify realized XRP-related payment volume.

arc_mainnet.interpretation: Arc is a separate Circle-associated layer-one network with its own ARC token. It is not XRPL and does not establish an XRP demand relationship.

issuer_disclosed_risk_factors: Competition from yield-bearing tokenized money-market funds may reduce demand for Circle stablecoins.
Stablecoin confidence shocks or redemption runs could cause rapid redemption requests and operational pressure.
Less favorable distribution arrangements or loss of distribution partners could adversely affect USDC circulation and financial results.
Arc and ARC token execution, security, regulatory, governance and adoption risks are material.

equity.transfer_and_hedging_restriction: From closing until the earlier of the second anniversary or termination of the commercial arrangements by Binance under specified circumstances, subject to customary exceptions.

commercial_agreement.circle_obligation: Pay Binance a monthly incentive fee representing a percentage of USDC held through Circle's Modular Smart Contract Wallet infrastructure service.
commercial_agreement.binance_obligation: Undertake activities to promote USDC on its platform.
commercial_agreement.early_termination: Either party may terminate before expiry upon specified events.

binance_circle_transaction.interpretation: This is a verified direct equity and commercial relationship between Binance and Circle. It may strengthen USDC distribution on Binance, but the filing does not quantify Binance's current USDC balances, incremental USDC circulation, or XRP purchases. It is not evidence of direct XRP demand.

derivatives_open_interest.explanation: The providers enumerate different venue and contract universes. Kodexius reports seven contracts across five venues; TradRadar reports seven exchanges; Bentley Markets reports seventeen exchanges. Their totals are not a common synchronized instrument universe and cannot be averaged or treated as one validated OI series.
derivatives_open_interest.note: The aggregators may consume overlapping underlying exchange feeds; separate publisher names do not establish independent primary data.

disagreement_and_quality.spot_and_depth: The spot price page has no explicit event timestamp; the depth heatmap combines spot and perpetual books and is stale. Neither is admissible as a synchronized point-in-time liquidity feature.
disagreement_and_quality.raw_receipts: All sources in this artifact lack byte-complete raw-source SHA-256 receipts. They are research-only and excluded from model training.

No evidence here links Binance's Circle investment to XRP holdings, XRP collateral utilization or XRP order flow

explicit_disconfirming_evidence: Circle's $13.9 trillion USDC on-chain volume is a gross transfer metric and does not prove net new capital.
Circle Payments Network's $41.3 billion annualized TPV is not actual quarterly settlement.
The ARC presale contributed $182 million of Q3 other revenue and is non-recurring.
The Circle/Binance SEC filing contains no XRP purchase, XRP collateral or XRP payment-volume commitment.
Derivatives OI provider totals are not comparable without a common contract and venue universe.
The account long/short ratio does not establish notional directional exposure.
The Tazapay acquisition is a definitive agreement expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approvals; it is not a completed acquisition.
Tazapay's $25B+ annualized payment volume and approximately 60% stablecoin share are Circle-reported metrics, not independently reconciled actual capital flows.
Samsung Wallet and Visa Direct announcements describe USDC rails; they do not establish XRP usage or XRP-related settlement demand.
Arc mainnet and ARC token are a separate network/token ecosystem; do not merge Arc activity into XRPL or XRP metrics.
The AInvest 'actual capital' phrase is a secondary AI-assisted statement about RLUSD; it is not evidence of XRP capital flows or a primary disclosure.
The candidate YouTube channel @drkamilahstevenson is not linked from the captured first-party site; subscriber counts and channel descriptions from directories do not prove identity.
Multiple same-name YouTube profiles with similar finance/crypto bios create a material risk of mistaken attribution; no public video inventory is authorized by the current evidence.
